$comment: Pilot: metric check (matrix). Hierarchical rows × columns to spot the cell that stands out. Change only rows, columns, values and format (heat · bar · sign). expand opens every row level.
name: Pilot-Matrix

Headline Heatmap.en: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( '날짜'[월] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [매출] ) ) VAR hi = TOPN ( 1, t, [매출], DESC ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, t, [매출], ASC ) RETURN "Peak month: " & CONCATENATEX ( hi, '날짜'[월], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MAXX ( hi, [매출] ) / [Unit Scale], "#,0.0" ) & [Unit Suffix] & "  ·  Low month: " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, '날짜'[월], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [매출] ) / [Unit Scale], "#,0.0" ) & [Unit Suffix] & "  ·  darker cell = higher sales"
Headline Heatmap.ko: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( '날짜'[월] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [매출] ) ) VAR hi = TOPN ( 1, t, [매출], DESC ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, t, [매출], ASC ) RETURN "가장 높은 달 " & CONCATENATEX ( hi, '날짜'[월], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MAXX ( hi, [매출] ) / [Unit Scale], "#,0" ) & [Unit Suffix] & "  ·  가장 낮은 달 " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, '날짜'[월], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [매출] ) / [Unit Scale], "#,0" ) & [Unit Suffix] & "  ·  진한 칸일수록 매출이 크다"

Headline Heat.expr: VAR _cells = FILTER ( CROSSJOIN ( VALUES ( '카테고리'[카테고리] ), VALUES ( '날짜'[월] ) ), NOT ISBLANK ( [목표 달성률] ) ) VAR _miss = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( _cells, [목표 달성률] < 1 ) ) VAR _n = COUNTROWS ( _cells ) VAR _by = ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( '카테고리'[카테고리] ), "M", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( '날짜'[월] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [목표 달성률] ) && [목표 달성률] < 1 ) ) ) VAR _worst = MAXX ( _by, [M] ) VAR _top = FILTER ( _by, [M] = _worst ) RETURN FORMAT ( _miss, "#,0" ) & " of " & FORMAT ( _n, "#,0" ) & " cells missed target" & " · most often: " & CONCATENATEX ( _top, '카테고리'[카테고리], ", " ) & " (" & FORMAT ( _worst, "#,0" ) & " months each)"

sub.en: Sales · darker = higher · use +/− on row headers to expand or collapse
sub.ko: 만 원 · 진할수록 크다 · 행 머리글의 +/−로 펼치고 접기

sub.en: Bar = sales · darker cell = higher margin · red = down vs last year
sub.ko: 막대 = 매출 크기 · 진한 칸 = 이익률이 높음 · 빨간 글자 = 전년보다 줄어듦

sub.en: One cell is one category in one month · red below plan, blue above, pale at 100%
sub.ko: 한 칸이 한 달의 한 카테고리 · 빨강은 목표 미달, 파랑은 초과, 100%는 옅은 색

sub.en: The grid shows when a category missed · this shows how much it cost over the year
sub.ko: 격자가 언제인지를, 이 막대가 한 해 동안 얼마였는지를 말한다
